datasets.name: QASPER
datasets.used: document ids, question ids and question text
datasets.selection: test split rows 0-9, all their questions (manifests/hybrid_search/SELECTION.md)

datasets.name: arXiv e-prints (PDF)
datasets.license: the arXiv license chosen by each article's authors (not recorded per file)
datasets.used: unmodified PDFs, fetched by prepare_data.py and checked against the manifest sha256

stand_in_services.name: rerank stand-in
stand_in_services.implementation: Cohere v1 response format; scores with FlashRank ms-marco-MiniLM-L-12-v2 on CPU; fixed 175 ms delay per request
stand_in_services.reason: no Cohere API key during development

local_state.index: raglite SQLite database built by build_index.py from the 10 PDFs (embeddings: OpenAI text-embedding-3-large); read-only at query time; one copy per client process

adaptations.what: answering LLM gpt-4o-mini instead of claude-3-opus-20240229
adaptations.why: the upstream model is retired and no Anthropic key was available

adaptations.what: rerank requests go to rerank_standin.py instead of api.cohere.ai; the app's own Cohere client is used, with its url attribute changed
configuration built by the driver (app_setup.build_config) instead of the sidebar form; db_url is a SQLite file chosen by the driver
adaptations.why: headless run; SQLite is the UI default backend

adaptations.what: headless driver: main() L186-207 without Streamlit display calls; every question in a fresh chat (empty history)
fallback branch (Anthropic, L187-190) is not run; a unit that reaches it is an error
adaptations.why: no Anthropic key; never reached on this corpus during development

adaptations.what: index built by calling process_document on each PDF path, not through the upload widget's temp copy
adaptations.why: headless; the document id is a hash of the file bytes, so the stored data is the same apart from the filename
litellm 1.53.9 cannot parse today's online model map; raglite would then assume a 2048-token context and refuse to run
silences the tokenizers fork warning; set in development
rerankers prints every rerank response; development runs discarded stdout too

adaptations.what: import serialized with a file lock
adaptations.why: importing raglite downloads two unused FlashRank models into ./.flashrank_cache; concurrent first imports race

adaptations.what: dependency pins added: litellm 1.53.9, numpy 1.26.4, llama-cpp-python 0.3.2
adaptations.why: litellm 1.15-1.52 are no longer on PyPI; spacy 3.7/thinc need numpy 1.x; the 0.3.35 metal wheel was malformed
